title: Student loan servicers begin 90-day countdown for borrowers to leave SAVE plan
title_zh: 学生贷款服务商开始为借款人退出 SAVE 计划进行 90 天倒计时
text: Student loan servicers have begun alerting borrowers that they have 90 days to leave the Biden-era SAVE plan. Here's what comes next.
zh: 学生贷款服务机构已开始提醒借款人，他们有 90 天的时间退出拜登时代的 SAVE 计划。接下来会发生什么。

title: Rivian, Tesla and the 'Holly Index': How to trade the new EV Main Street battle
title_zh: Rivian、特斯拉和“Holly Index”：如何在新的电动汽车大街之战中进行交易
text: Mike Khouw gives a trade on Rivian and Tesla, informed by his wife's recent auto purchase.
zh: Mike Khouw 根据他妻子最近购买的汽车的信息，对 Rivian 和特斯拉进行了交易。

title: Why Jim Cramer says this AI play — up 85% this year — is headed even higher
title_zh: 为什么吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示人工智能游戏今年增长了 85%，未来还会更高
text: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.
zh: 投资俱乐部在每个工作日上午 10:20（东部时间）举行“晨会”。

title: Feds seek lower prison term for $100M New Jersey deli fraudster — but some reasons why are hidden
title_zh: 联邦调查局寻求降低新泽西州价值 1 亿美元的熟食欺诈者的刑期，但其中的一些原因被隐藏
text: James Patten is the third person who will be sentenced in the stock manipulation scheme related to Hometown International, a company that owned just one deli.
zh: 詹姆斯·彭定康 (James Patten) 是因与 Hometown International 相关的股票操纵计划而被判刑的第三人，该公司只拥有一家熟食店。

title: First known congressional SpaceX stock buys surface after record IPO
title_zh: 首次公开募股创纪录后，第一支已知的国会 SpaceX 股票被买入
text: The SpaceX stock purchases come as Elon Musk’s company deepens its role in federal contracting and remains closely tied to President Donald Trump’s Washington.
zh: 此次购买 SpaceX 股票之际，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的公司正在深化其在联邦合同领域的作用，并与唐纳德·特朗普总统的华盛顿保持密切联系。

title: Your 5 biggest questions about ‘Trump accounts,’ answered
title_zh: 关于“特朗普账户”的 5 个最大问题已得到解答
text: Here’s who is eligible for $1,000 in free money — and how to sign up.
zh: 以下是谁有资格获得 1,000 美元的免费奖金以及如何注册。

title: Nine microcap stocks of companies expected to grow sales by triple digits through 2028
title_zh: 预计到 2028 年，九只微型股票的销售额将实现三位数增长
text: The Russell Microcap Index has more than doubled the performance of the S&P 500 this year.
zh: 罗素微型股指数今年的表现是标准普尔 500 指数的两倍多。

title: Strategy is losing a lot of money on bitcoin. Here’s why it’s selling anyway.
title_zh: 策略是在比特币上损失很多钱。这就是它仍然畅销的原因。
text: Strategy sold more than 3,000 bitcoins to raise cash to pay dividends on its preferred stock — something Executive Chair Michael Saylor had previously said it didn’t need to do.
zh: Strategy 出售了 3,000 多个比特币，以筹集现金来支付其优先股股息——执行主席 Michael Saylor 此前曾表示，公司不需要这样做。

title: Your investing expectations are more than double the reality. Here is the tough truth.
title_zh: 您的投资预期是实际情况的两倍以上。这是残酷的事实。
text: Long-term real returns above 10% annualized are exceedingly rare.
zh: 长期实际回报率超过年化 10% 的情况极为罕见。

title: Software stocks have rarely seen such divergent performances. Here’s how to pick winners.
title_zh: 软件股很少出现如此分化的表现。以下是如何选出获胜者。
text: An Evercore analyst notes that infrastructure software stocks have vastly outperformed application names. But there’s still hope for companies like Salesforce.
zh: Evercore 分析师指出，基础设施软件股票的表现远远优于应用程序股票。但像 Salesforce 这样的公司仍然有希望。

title: Xbox’s CEO says the business is ‘not healthy’ as it prepares for 3,200 layoffs
title_zh: Xbox CEO 称公司业务“不健康” 准备裁员 3200 人
text: With shares down 20% this year, Microsoft joins peers like Meta and Oracle in using layoffs to offset rising costs of the AI race
zh: 今年股价下跌 20%，微软与 Meta 和 Oracle 等同行一起通过裁员来抵消 AI 竞赛成本上升的影响

title: The Century-Old Engine Driving The U.S. Economy And Stocks - Investor's Business Daily
title_zh: 驱动美国经济和股市的百年引擎 - 投资者商业日报
text: The Century-Old Engine Driving The U.S. Economy And Stocks Investor's Business Daily
zh: 驱动美国经济和股市的百年引擎 投资者商业日报

title: Our economic outlook for China - Vanguard Corporate
title_zh: 我们对中国经济的展望 - Vanguard Corporate
text: Our economic outlook for China Vanguard Corporate
zh: 我们对中国先锋集团的经济展望

title: Chinese Economy Is Booming, But Stock Markets Haven’t Recovered in 20 Years - Yahoo Finance
title_zh: 中国经济蓬勃发展，股市20年未复苏 - 雅虎财经
text: Chinese Economy Is Booming, But Stock Markets Haven’t Recovered in 20 Years Yahoo Finance
zh: 中国经济蓬勃发展，但股市20年未复苏 雅虎财经

title: China’s Stocks, Bonds in Rare Sync as War Drives Haven Demand - Bloomberg.com
title_zh: 战争推动避险需求，中国股市和债券罕见同步 - Bloomberg.com
text: China’s Stocks, Bonds in Rare Sync as War Drives Haven Demand Bloomberg.com
zh: 战争推动避险需求，中国股市和债券罕见同步 Bloomberg.com

title: Microsoft cuts 4,800 jobs, as Xbox unit downsizes and plans to spin off four gaming studios
title_zh: 微软裁员 4,800 人，Xbox 部门缩小规模并计划分拆四个游戏工作室
text: Microsoft is cutting jobs in its commercial business and its Xbox gaming group, where revenue has been shrinking.
zh: 微软正在削减其商业业务和 Xbox 游戏部门的工作岗位，该部门的收入一直在萎缩。

title: Trump plugs Dell at first-ever White House opening bell, sending shares soaring
title_zh: 特朗普在白宫首次开门钟声中插入戴尔，推动股价飙升
text: Trump rang the bell in the Oval Office to open Monday's trading as he launched investment accounts for babies born from 2025 through 2028.
zh: 特朗普在椭圆形办公室敲响了周一交易的钟声，他为 2025 年至 2028 年出生的婴儿开设了投资账户。

title: Trump defends call urging Balogun red card review: 'It wasn't a foul'
title_zh: 特朗普为敦促巴洛贡红牌审查的呼吁进行辩护：“这不是犯规”
text: "I didn't know what the hell a red card was," said Trump, who called FIFA President Gianni Infantino about the suspension of Folarin Balogun.
zh: “我不知道红牌到底是什么，”特朗普说道，他就福拉林·巴洛贡的停赛一事给国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺打电话。

title: Klarna seeks U.S. bank charter in latest push beyond buy now, pay later
title_zh: 克拉纳寻求美国银行牌照，以超越“先买后付”的最新举措
text: Klarna joins a wave of fintech and crypto firms seeking entry to the traditional banking system.
zh: Klarna 加入了寻求进入传统银行系统的金融科技和加密货币公司浪潮。

title: SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell to donate stock to Trump Accounts
title_zh: SpaceX 总裁格温·肖特韦尔 (Gwynne Shotwell) 将向特朗普账户捐赠股票
text: President Donald Trump told CNBC's Joe Kernen last week that he thought SpaceX CEO Elon Musk would donate company stock to the program.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统上周告诉 CNBC 的乔·科南，他认为 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克将向该项目捐赠公司股票。

title: NATO tensions are ‘growing pains,’ U.S. ambassador says as Trump presses allies
title_zh: 特朗普向盟友施压时，美国大使表示北约紧张局势是“成长的烦恼”
text: U.S. Ambassador to NATO Matthew Whitaker said NATO's allies boosting defense spending under pressure from Trump reflects “growing pains,” not a crisis.
zh: 美国驻北约大使马修·惠特克表示，北约盟国在特朗普的压力下增加国防开支反映了“成长的烦恼”，而不是危机。

title: Belgium challenges Balogun eligibility for World Cup game after Trump intervention
title_zh: 特朗普干预后比利时挑战巴洛贡参加世界杯比赛的资格
text: FIFA reversed Folarin Balogun’s suspension after Trump sought a review, letting the U.S. striker play Belgium as officials objected.
zh: 在特朗普寻求审查后，国际足联撤销了对福拉林·巴洛贡的禁赛令，允许这位美国前锋对阵比利时，尽管官员们表示反对。

title: 'Electronic warfare is a tech phenomenon': Why the market is rethinking defense valuations
title_zh: “电子战是一种科技现象”：为什么市场正在重新考虑国防估值
text: There's a growing investment in newer areas of defense such as deep strike capabilities, anti-drone and unmanned systems, with different priorities for different countries.
zh: 对纵深打击能力、反无人机和无人系统等新防御领域的投资不断增加，不同国家有不同的优先事项。

title: We're booking big profits in a cyber stock that's rallied back to record highs
title_zh: 我们在一只反弹至历史新高的网络股票上获得了巨额利润
text: Our two cybersecurity stocks have been two of the stronger positions in the portfolio lately.
zh: 我们的两只网络安全股票最近是投资组合中实力较强的两只。

title: Micron’s stock gains, signaling a ‘return to optimism’ about the chip sector
title_zh: 美光科技股价上涨，表明芯片行业“回归乐观”
text: Investors are looking forward to Samsung’s earnings and SK Hynix’s ADR listing, experts say.
zh: 专家表示，投资者正在期待三星的财报和 SK 海力士的 ADR 上市。

title: Trump rings Wall Street opening bells and says the stock market ‘is going to go through the roof’
title_zh: 特朗普敲响华尔街开市钟并称股市“将冲破屋顶”
text: Trump used the occasion to promote the launch of “Trump accounts,” which are special investment accounts for children under age 18.
zh: 特朗普利用这个机会宣传“特朗普账户”的推出，这是针对 18 岁以下儿童的特殊投资账户。

title: TeraWulf’s stock surges after a $19 billion deal with Anthropic
title_zh: 与 Anthropic 达成 190 亿美元交易后，TeraWulf 股价飙升
text: The deal “validates” the crypto-mining company’s pivot to supporting the AI buildout, its CEO said.
zh: 该公司首席执行官表示，这笔交易“验证了”这家加密货币矿业公司支持人工智能建设的重点。

title: ‘The money would have been life-changing’: My father told my grandmother to slash my inheritance. Is that fair?
title_zh: “这笔钱本来可以改变我的生活”：我的父亲告诉我的祖母削减我的遗产。这公平吗？
text: “I could have bought a home for what I hope will be a growing family.”
zh: “我本可以为我希望成长的家庭买一套房子。”

title: How parents can take advantage of the ‘best summer-camp tax break in years’
title_zh: 家长如何利用“多年来最好的夏令营税收减免”
text: For many kids, summer means camp. For many of their parents, that means financial juggling to pay for those camp experiences.
zh: 对于许多孩子来说，夏天意味着露营。对于他们的许多父母来说，这意味着要在经济上周旋以支付这些夏令营的费用。

title: Global stocks may be headed for a summer swoon. Why AI won’t be the only story that matters, JPMorgan says
title_zh: 全球股市可能会在夏季陷入低迷。摩根大通表示，为什么人工智能不会是唯一重要的故事
text: Strategists at the investment bank outlined five key drivers for global equities in the months ahead
zh: 该投行策略师概述了未来几个月全球股市的五个关键驱动因素

title: Versant agrees to buy golf simulator company Full Swing for $530 million
title_zh: Versant 同意以 5.3 亿美元收购高尔夫模拟器公司 Full Swing
text: The deal for Full Swing will expand Versant's non-traditional media assets in an effort to diversify revenue from cable television.
zh: Full Swing 的交易将扩大 Versant 的非传统媒体资产，以实现有线电视收入多元化。

title: TeraWulf shares soar after Anthropic leases data center in Kentucky
title_zh: Anthropic 租赁肯塔基州数据中心后 TeraWulf 股价飙升
text: TeraWulf is a crytpo mining company that has pivoted to AI data center infrastructure. Its stock is up more than 80% this year.
zh: TeraWulf 是一家加密货币挖矿公司，已转向人工智能数据中心基础设施。今年以来，其股价上涨了80%以上。

title: Record heat, crowds drive offseason boom in international travel
title_zh: 创纪录的高温和人群推动休赛期国际旅行的繁荣
text: Airlines are extending flight schedules to maximize on lucrative international travel.
zh: 航空公司正在延长航班时刻表，以最大限度地提高利润丰厚的国际旅行。

title: EasyJet shares soar 10% as budget airline agrees to $7.3 billion Castlelake takeover
title_zh: 廉价航空公司同意以 73 亿美元收购 Castlelake，易捷航空股价飙升 10%
text: EasyJet shares surged in early dealmaking Monday after it agreed in principle to takeover bid from Castlelake.
zh: 易捷航空原则上同意收购 Castlelake 的收购要约，周一早期交易中股价飙升。

title: South Korean prosecutors indict four major refiners over allegations of oil price collusion
title_zh: 韩国检方起诉四家主要炼油厂涉嫌串谋油价
text: South Korean prosecutors on Monday indicted four major domestic oil refiners for violating fair trade laws.
zh: 韩国检察官周一起诉国内四家主要炼油厂违反公平贸易法。

title: Treasury Secretary Bessent backs rate cuts but says he understands if the Fed wants to wait
title_zh: 财政部长贝森特支持降息，但表示他理解美联储是否愿意等待
text: Bessent has previously said the Fed should hasten cutting interest rates, calling reductions "the only ingredient missing" for stronger economic growth.
zh: 贝森特此前曾表示，美联储应加快降息，称降息是经济增长强劲的“唯一缺失的因素”。

title: Warren Buffett says he sold Apple too soon and would buy more of it, though not in this market
title_zh: 沃伦·巴菲特表示，他太早卖掉了苹果公司，并将购买更多苹果公司，尽管不是在这个市场
text: Apple remains Berkshire Hathaway's largest holding even after the conglomerate trimmed its stake at the end of last year.
zh: 即使伯克希尔哈撒韦公司去年底减持了其股份，苹果公司仍然是伯克希尔哈撒韦公司最大的持股公司。

title: As oil exits the ‘danger zone,’ here’s what history suggests happens next for stocks
title_zh: 随着石油退出“危险区域”，历史表明股市接下来会发生什么
text: The swift pullback in oil prices is a tailwind for the economy, says Evercore ISI
zh: Evercore ISI 表示，油价迅速回落是经济的推动力

title: AI hyperscalers are poised for a big comeback rally as chip gains cool, says Morgan Stanley
title_zh: 摩根士丹利表示，随着芯片降温，人工智能超大规模企业将迎来大幅卷土重来
text: The once-hot semiconductor trade has seen a cooling in the last couple of weeks, which is not only likely to continue, but usher in a bumpy ride for the overall stock market.
zh: 曾经炙手可热的半导体贸易在过去几周出现降温，这种情况不仅可能持续下去，而且会给整个股市带来坎坷。

title: You want a portfolio that matches your morals. But that could sink your retirement plans.
title_zh: 您想要一个符合您道德的投资组合。但这可能会毁掉你的退休计划。
text: More investors want their money to reflect their values. It feels righteous — but the reality is a lot messier.
zh: 更多的投资者希望他们的钱能够反映他们的价值观。这感觉很正义——但现实要混乱得多。

title: I have no kids. Will I cause family drama by leaving different amounts to my nieces and nephews?
title_zh: 我没有孩子。我给侄女和侄子留下不同数额的钱会引起家庭闹剧吗？
text: “Part of me would prefer to leave more to those for whom the money could make a meaningful difference.”
zh: “我内心的一部分更愿意把更多的钱留给那些能够产生有意义的改变的人。”

title: Stocks rally when Congress goes on summer break. Here is the hidden reason.
title_zh: 国会暑假期间股市上涨。这就是隐藏的原因。
text: Stock prices face greater volatility when lawmakers are active, driven entirely by the regulatory uncertainty they create.
zh: 当立法者表现活跃时，股票价格将面临更大的波动，这完全是由他们造成的监管不确定性驱动的。

title: Your share of the AI wealth is a right — not a handout. Here is how we claw back our money.
title_zh: 你分享人工智能财富是一种权利，而不是施舍。以下是我们如何收回我们的钱。
text: Why we actually own the capital behind the AI revolution.
zh: 为什么我们实际上拥有人工智能革命背后的资本。

title: Highflying hedge fund run by former OpenAI researcher will be cornerstone investor in SK Hynix U.S. listing
title_zh: 由前 OpenAI 研究员运营的 Highflying 对冲基金将成为 SK 海力士美国上市的基石投资者
text: Three major investors in the technology sector will back SK Hynix’s offering of American depository receipts that is expected this week.
zh: 科技行业的三大投资者将支持 SK 海力士预计于本周发行的美国存托凭证。

title: ‘I’ve plenty of time on my hands’: Advisers bombard me with offers of free steak. Is it wrong to go for the food?
title_zh: “我手头有很多时间”：顾问们不断向我提供免费牛排。去吃饭有错吗？
text: “I get hungry for a meal at a good restaurant.”
zh: “我饿了，想去一家好餐厅吃饭。”

title: Trump's calls, Ukraine's strikes and Russia's barrage on Kyiv put markets on alert
title_zh: 特朗普的呼吁、乌克兰的空袭以及俄罗斯对基辅的猛攻让市场保持警惕
text: Trump reportedly spoke with Putin and Zelenskyy as Ukraine struck Russian targets and Moscow launched another deadly attack on Kyiv.
zh: 据报道，在乌克兰袭击俄罗斯目标以及莫斯科对基辅发动另一次致命袭击时，特朗普与普京和泽连斯基进行了交谈。

title: 'NATO 3.0': Defense spending pledges face the Trump test
title_zh: “北约3.0”：国防支出承诺面临特朗普考验
text: Leaders are expected to focus on whether Europe can turn higher defense spending into military power as Washington pushes allies to shoulder more of the burden.
zh: 随着华盛顿敦促盟友承担更多负担，预计领导人将关注欧洲能否将更高的国防开支转化为军事力量。

title: Why Iran may find it difficult to clear its oil inventories even after sanctions relief
title_zh: 为什么伊朗即使在制裁解除后也可能很难清理其石油库存
text: Iran may face challenges in clearing oil inventories even after restrictions have been lifted, amid oil supplies elsewhere while China becomes less enthusiastic
zh: 即使解除限制，伊朗在清理石油库存方面也可能面临挑战，因为其他地区的石油供应而中国的热情却有所下降

title: Ebola outbreak containment hampered by USAID closure, experts say
title_zh: 专家表示，美国国际开发署的关闭阻碍了埃博拉疫情的遏制
text: Foreign aid cuts have "demonstrably worsened" the Ebola crisis, a virologist told CNBC.
zh: 一位病毒学家告诉 CNBC，削减外国援助“明显加剧了”埃博拉危机。

title: Meta’s woes deepen in India as child abuse ads on Instagram draw government ire
title_zh: Instagram 上的虐待儿童广告引起政府愤怒，Meta 在印度的困境进一步加深
text: U.S. social media giant Meta is facing an onslaught of regulatory scrutiny in India, which has the largest user base for Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.
zh: 美国社交媒体巨头 Meta 在印度面临监管审查的猛烈攻击，印度拥有 Facebook、Instagram 和 WhatsApp 最大的用户群。

title: As ACA enrollment falls by millions, Trump administration and policy gurus disagree on why
title_zh: 随着 ACA 入学人数下降数百万人，特朗普政府和政策专家对于原因存在分歧
text: Affordable Care Act marketplace enrollment has declined by 3 million people. The Trump administration points to fraud controls. Policy experts point to cost.
zh: 《平价医疗法案》市场注册人数减少了 300 万人。特朗普政府指出了欺诈控制措施。政策专家指出成本。

title: Don't throw away your shot to speak to an AI Alexander Hamilton at Boston's new finance museum
title_zh: 不要放弃在波士顿新金融博物馆与人工智能亚历山大·汉密尔顿交谈的机会
text: Nearly a decade after leaving its former home, the Museum of American Finance is opening its new doors to the public.
zh: 离开旧址近十年后，美国金融博物馆向公众敞开了新的大门。

title: Just a week after spin-off plan, Comcast says it will buy British broadcaster
